scope_note: This identifies the German base edition of the English text used in this pilot; it is not the first German edition.
statement: Titchener's English Principles of Physiological Psychology was translated from Wundt's fifth German edition of 1902.
statement_zh: Titchener 的英譯本《Principles of Physiological Psychology》譯自 Wundt 於 1902 年出版的德文第五版。
